variants.name: Beef 415 g
variants.about_this_item:
SIMBA DOG CHUNKS WITH BEEF is a complete pet food for adult dogs of all sizes. Chunks in gravy formulated with quality ingredients such as beef, source of protein and minerals, are oven-baked to enhance their natural taste and stimulate your pet's daily appetite. The formulation has been developed with a specific combination of vitamins A-D3-E to meet the nutritional requirements of your pet's daily needs. No added colours or preservatives.

  • Complete pet food for adult dogs of all sizes
  • Chunks in gravy, oven cooked
  • No added colours or preservatives
  • No cruelty test
  • Made in Italy
  • Pack size: 415 g
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: meat and animal derivatives (beef 6%), cereals, eggs and egg derivatives, minerals.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 8.0%, crude fibre 1.21%, crude fat 6.0%, crude ash 3%, moisture 80.0%.

Additives (nutritional additives/kg): Vitamin A (Retinyl Acetate) 2000 IU, Vitamin D3 200 IU, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl acetate 3a700i) 5 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions:
Instructions for use: To be served at room temperature. Leave always available to the animal fresh and clean water. Refrigerate unused portion and consume within 2 days. Recommended daily feeding intakes (see table) may be split into 2 daily meals. Do not open the can, if it is dented or swollen. Animal food, not suitable for human consumption.

Recommended daily feeding intakes (grams/day):

Weight of adult dog (kg)5-99-1515-25>25
Daily feed (grams/day)400-620620-900900-1350>1350
